reviews.review:
A fantastic "kite and shoot" survival, platforming shooter.

Tons of fun, really, I play it all day.

Fun game.
Good platformer, amazing rogue-lite.
There are a fair number of playable characters, with their own abilities, and a good deal of enemies.
The single player is amazing. There is an immense amount of replayability.
Local multiplayer is good, but players share a single screen, so people need to choose characters roughly around the same speed levels & divvy up speed items fairly when they drop....that can be annoying for obvious reasons.
Online multiplayer is amazing, just as great as single player, but it can be a little weird to set up. It isn't a premade/matchmaking system like a lot of games. The host needs to port forward and possibly allow for the use of certain ports in firewall settings. There are several good, easy guides on how to do this, but if you know you aren't any good with computers.....it's gonna suck. Please do not get the game for online multiplayer if you or one of your friends is not comfortable with this type of setup.
With that being said, I highly recommend it for its simplistic, yet detailed and high skill-cap gameplay.
P.S. If you get it, look up how to get the COMMAND artifact and GLASS artifact. Makes unlocking a lot of the characters and other artifacts way easier. Also, if you don't like a character in single player and then decide to play with a bud....it might be worth it to try that character again. A lot of them get immensely better because they play more of a supporting role, or need someone to support them a little to set up some massive damage nukes *cough* sniper *cough*
I remember when I first made a review of this game that I completely sucked at the game now that I am older and actualy know how to play this game is completly amazing.
I sink way more hours in that i should've.
